title: Pokemon Beach Court 263/182 Paradox Rift Gold Secret Rare NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokémon TCG — Beach Court, #263/182, Paradox Rift (SV4). Trainer — Stadium card.
Retreat Cost of each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is 1 less. Only 1 Stadium in play at a time. Illustrated by Oswaldo KATO. Card number exceeds the set's base count of 182, indicating a gold secret rare print.
Ungraded, near mint or better — see photos for the actual card. Ships sleeved in a top-loader inside a rigid mailer.
